name: codex-peer
description: Use a second local Codex session from inside Codex through the Codex app server.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate review and coding tasks to another Codex session.
interface.longDescription: Codex Peer exposes a read-only reviewer and an opt-in writable delegate backed by the local Codex app server.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ask a second Codex session to review the current changes.
